title: feat(spec)!: a locale tag written in another case is corrected to its BCP-47 case
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRmpbFs6uQ8AuadsTr
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99S5MraEqnBqEXczLZy23mg)_
Fixes #28993

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` (the "Case is not judged: the resolvers fold it" sentence now says case is corrected on parse, a stored row's locale is folded by the conversion `translation-locale-tag-case-folded`, and a bundle with two keys that fold to one tag is refused). `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` already spells every tag in its canonical case and teaches no case rule, so no skill text or eval moves.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:区域标签(locale)大小写写得不标准时,解析会改成 BCP-47 标准写法(`zh-cn` → `zh-CN`,`zh-hans-cn` → `zh-Hans-CN`),只改大小写,不改别的;库里已经按 `zh-cn` 存下的翻译,读出时由一个新的存量转换(`translation-locale-tag-case-folded`)按标准写法归位。同一个翻译包里同时写了 `zh-cn` 和 `zh-CN` 两个键,会被拒绝并点名两个键。
- 为什么改:翻译以 `zh-cn` 保存时接口回 200,但 `zh-CN` 会话永远看不到这些翻译(#28993),因为语言解析先精确匹配,内置的 `zh-CN` 包总是先命中。现在解析层只留一种写法,每个读者看到同一个标签。
- 风险与回滚:这是一处破坏性收窄(BREAKING),落地要你拍板:同一个翻译包里只差大小写的两个键(如 `zh-cn` 和 `zh-CN`)以前能通过,现在会被拒绝并点名两个键,仓内命中 0 处。大小写更正本身是放宽,其它原来能通过的输入照样通过,JSON Schema 不变。还有两处按原写法精确比较的地方(邮件模板的语言下限告警、通知模板的语言梯):配置里写成 `zh-cn` 的默认或支持语言现在读作 `zh-CN`,存量模板行若仍标 `zh-cn` 就对不上,需要把模板行改成标准写法,行侧归位随 server 车道的入口卡落地。如果你选合并,一笔提交就能换成「按标准写法的键优先合并」,声明行回到 yes (widening) / semantic,不再是破坏性改动。保存入口仍原样存 `zh-cn`(入口属 server 车道,另起一张卡),但读出已归位,不影响本卡效果。回滚即撤掉本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`(`canonicalLocaleCase` 与两个翻译包 schema 上的 `superRefine` / `overwrite`);`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` 新增的 `translation-locale-tag-case-folded`(存量行大小写归位,排在 #25822 的 `translation-locale-tag-canonicalized` 之后);`packages/spec/src/system/translation.test.ts` 新增的一组测试。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/translation.test.ts`,应全部通过,其中包含新增的「LocaleSchema corrects a tag to its BCP-47 case (#28993)」一组。
- 需要你做的:回答席位的决策卡:同一翻译包里只差大小写的两个键,是拒绝还是合并。

## What changes

- **`LocaleSchema` corrects case** (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`). A tag that passes `LOCALE_TAG_SHAPE` is returned in its BCP-47 case (RFC 5646 §2.1.1): the language subtag lower case, a 4-letter script title case, a 2-letter region upper case, any other subtag lower case, and every subtag after a singleton lower case. The fold is `.overwrite(canonicalLocaleCase)`, so `z.input` and `z.output` are both `string`, `Locale` stays `z.input`, and the published JSON Schema does not move (`check:generated` regenerated nothing). A canonical tag is returned unchanged, and nothing that parsed before is refused except the bundle case below.
  - **Case only, not `Intl.getCanonicalLocales`.** Measured on Node v22.23.4: `Intl.getCanonicalLocales` rewrites more than case (`iw` → `he`, `in` → `id`, `tl` → `fil`, `cmn` → `zh`, `mo` → `ro`, `art-lojban` → `jbo`, `en-us-POSIX` → `en-US-u-va-posix`) and throws on tags `LOCALE_TAG_SHAPE` accepts (`zh-Hans-Hans`, `sgn-BE-FR`, `en-GB-oed`, `ar-aao`, `en-a-b`). Replacing a legacy subtag would move a translation to a locale its author never named, and the answer would depend on the runtime's ICU data.
  - **Readers whose output changes:** a translation item's `locale`; `TranslationBundle` / `PlatformTranslationBundle` keys; `i18n.defaultLocale`, `fallbackLocale`, `supportedLocales`; a seed dataset's `locale` scope (`data/seed.zod.ts`) and the seed loader's `locale` (`data/seed-loader.zod.ts`). `EmailTemplateDefinitionSchema.locale` does not use `LocaleSchema` and is untouched (#28896 / #29014 unaffected); `PackageLocaleSchema` (marketplace) is a separate schema and is untouched.
- **Bundle keys fold, and two keys that fold to one tag are refused** (the narrowing, BREAKING; see Acceptance notes). Both bundle schemas are now `z.record(LocaleTagKeySchema, …).superRefine(refuseLocaleKeysFoldingTogether).overwrite(foldLocaleKeys)`. The key schema is a shape-only twin of `LocaleSchema` (same regex, message and description, no fold): a folding key schema would let `z.record` keep the later of two colliding keys and drop the other with no issue. The refinement runs before the fold and refuses `{ 'zh-cn': …, 'zh-CN': … }` with a `custom` issue at the second key, naming both keys, the tag and the release (`Refused since @objectstack/spec 18`). The fold then rebuilds the record with canonical keys, in order, and returns the input itself when every key is already canonical.
- **Stored rows read back canonical, through a D2 entry of their own** (`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`). The new ADR-0087 D2 conversion `translation-locale-tag-case-folded` (`toMajor: 18`, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '18.2.0'`, the same surface as #25822's entry) folds a tag in another case to the `LocaleSchema` parse: an item's `locale`, `i18n.defaultLocale` / `fallbackLocale` / `supportedLocales`, `data[].locale[]` and bundle keys, one notice each. It folds tag-shaped values only and leaves the rest to the entry before it. A bundle key that folds onto a key already holding different strings is left as stored and reported as a TODO (naming the release); an identical twin is merged by `renameKey`. Its `order` is 76.5, right after #25822's `translation-locale-tag-canonicalized` (76), so an underscore spelling is made a tag first and folded second (`zh_cn` → `zh-cn` → `zh-CN`).
  - **#25822's entry keeps its own stamp.** `translation-locale-tag-canonicalized` stays `retiredAfter: '18.1.0'` with its code unchanged: its docblock now says case is kept as written there and points at the case entry, retired a release later, because the premise that every resolver folds case was measured false. Its fixture moves only to stay disjoint (see Forced test edits).
  - **Why stored rows need it.** The save door (`saveMetaItem`) stores the authored body, so a `zh-cn` save stays `zh-cn` at rest; core's `readAuthoredTranslationLayer` replays the full conversion chain over each stored row before keying it by `data.locale`, so the row reaches `zh-CN` sessions from the next sync on, with nothing to re-save. An artifact built by `@objectstack/spec` 18.2.0 or earlier is folded the same way inside its declared-floor window.
- **Exact matchers that read a folded locale against a row tagged as written.** Two consumers compare a folded i18n locale with a row whose locale is not folded: the email-template floor warning (`warnEmailTemplateLocaleFloor` in `stack.zod.ts`) compares `i18n.supportedLocales` with `emailTemplates[].locale`, and the messaging template ladder compares `localeCandidates(i18n.getDefaultLocale())` with `sys_notification_template.locale`. A row tagged `zh-cn` no longer matches a supported or default locale authored as `zh-cn`, which now reads `zh-CN`. The D3 entry's replacement and acceptance criteria name both: the consumer folds case or the row is re-tagged, and the row-side fold lands with the server sibling card (the save door storing the parsed locale). Not changed here.
- **Upgrade path:** new ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.translation-locale-case-canonicalized.ts`, `conversionIds: ['translation-locale-tag-case-folded']`. The sibling entry `18.translation-locale-non-tag-refused.ts` said case is not refused because the resolvers fold it; it now says the parse corrects it.
- **Docs:** `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`, one paragraph (see `Skills-docs:`). This file is outside the claim's listed surface: a bounded in-place fix of a sentence this diff makes false.
- **Dropped-refinements ledger** (`packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`): +6 sites, 983 → 989. The bundle `superRefine` has no JSON Schema form, so it lands at the root of `system/TranslationBundle` and `system/PlatformTranslationBundle`, and at `manifest.translations.element` in the four `api/*InstalledPackage*` responses that embed a bundle. Entries are the ones the spec build's gate printed.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/28993-locale-case-canonicalized.md`, `@objectstack/spec: minor`, titled `feat(spec)!:`. It carries the two declaration lines above, a **BREAKING** banner for the refusal with its migration (FROM a bundle holding both spellings, `{ 'zh-cn': A, 'zh-CN': B }`, TO one canonical key holding both sets of strings, merged by hand), and one ADR-0087 disposition, `registered translation-locale-case-canonicalized` (the D3 entry is new in this diff and prescribes that merge). Its stored-rows bullet names the new conversion, and a bullet names the two exact matchers.
- **Not changed, on purpose:** core `memory-i18n.ts#resolveLocale` (triage 6570179836: no third runtime case-fold); the save door in `packages/metadata-protocol` (domain:server, handed off as a sibling card); the two exact matchers above.

### Forced test edits

- `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`, the fixture of #25822's `translation-locale-tag-canonicalized`: its stored item `locale: 'pt-br'` is now `pt-BR` on both sides (`before` and `after`), `expectedNotices` unchanged at 7. The fixture runner replays the whole chain, so a `pt-br` there would now be folded by the case entry and give one notice that is not this entry's; fixtures stay disjoint. The case belongs to the new entry's fixture.
- `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`: `translation-locale-tag-case-folded` is retired after 18.2.0, the newest published stable release, so the census pin requires a `JOIN` row with the prescriptions an author meets. A lone tag is corrected, not refused, so the row reads the collision two keys of one bundle make once folded: the bundle refusal at the parse, and the conversion's TODO for a stored pair (a new `todo` row kind, for a data-at-rest prescription that has no parse refusal to read). Both messages now name `@objectstack/spec 18`, which the row derives from the stamp.
- `packages/spec/src/system/translation.test.ts`: the existing `accepts the tag %j (case is not judged)` row is retitled `(case is corrected, never refused)`. Its assertion is unchanged; the old title stated the rule this PR reverses.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/system/translation.test.ts`, new describe `LocaleSchema corrects a tag to its BCP-47 case (#28993)`:

- Fold table: `zh-cn`, `ZH-CN` → `zh-CN`; `zh-hans-cn`, `ZH-HANS-cn` → `zh-Hans-CN`; `EN` → `en`; `en-us` → `en-US`; `yue-hk` → `yue-HK`; `sr-LATN-rs` → `sr-Latn-RS`; `es-419`, `de-1996` unchanged; `en-US-u-CA-Gregory` → `en-US-u-ca-gregory`; `en-x-US` → `en-x-us`.
- A canonical tag is returned unchanged (6 tags).
- Case only: `iw` stays `iw`, `TL` → `tl`, `cmn-cn` → `cmn-CN`, and `zh-hans-hans` → `zh-Hans-Hans` (a tag `Intl.getCanonicalLocales` throws on).
- Every reader sees the canonical spelling: a translation item, `defineTranslation`, `TranslationConfig` (`defaultLocale`, `fallbackLocale`, `supportedLocales`), `SeedSchema.locale`, `SeedLoaderConfig.locale`.
- Bundle keys are folded, in authored order, values untouched: `TranslationBundleSchema`, `defineTranslationBundle`, `PlatformTranslationBundleSchema`.
- Refusal: both bundle schemas refuse `zh-cn` beside `zh-CN` with exactly `[['custom', 'zh-CN']]` (code, path), and the message names both keys.
- CONTROL accepts: distinct tags in one bundle (`zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `zh-hans-cn`); `zh-cn` in one bundle and `zh-CN` in another, each parsed on its own (two bundles of `stack.translations` are separate records the runtime merges per locale).
- Stored-row seam: `applyConversionsToStoredItem('translation', { locale: 'zh-cn', … })` reads back `zh-CN`; a canonical row reads back equal; an underscored `zh_cn` row reads back `zh-CN` (the order: #25822's entry makes it a tag, the case entry folds it).
- Case entry at rest: `retiredAfter` is `18.2.0`; a bundle with `zh-cn` beside a different `zh-CN` is left as stored with one TODO at `translations[0].zh-cn`; an identical `ja-jp` / `ja-JP` twin is merged with one notice.
- The case entry's own fixture (run by the conversion fixture suite over the whole chain): `pt-br` → `pt-BR`, bundle keys `ko-kr` → `ko-KR` and `IT` → `it`, `i18n` `en-us` → `en-US` and `zh-hans-cn` → `zh-Hans-CN`, `data[].locale` `zh-cn` → `zh-CN`; 7 notices.

## Acceptance notes

- **The narrowing beside the widening.** A bundle holding two keys that fold to one tag parses on `main` today (both keys kept). After this PR it is refused, naming both keys. Measured on `6b3ba82c` over every TS/TSX/JS/MJS/CJS/JSON/YAML file in the repo: 0 such pairs, and 0 locale-keyed bundle keys in a non-canonical case outside tests and the conversion fixtures. Under AGENTS.md's level precedence (a value refused is `narrowed`, `narrowed` over `semantic`) the seat amended the claim (6573207423) to `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` / `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, and this body and the changeset carry those lines. Landing waits for the maintainer's word on the seat's decision card: refuse naming both keys, or merge with the canonical key winning. The merge is prepared as a one-commit swap on top of this head (8 files, +85 / -92: the refinement and its ledger lines go, `foldLocaleKeys` deep-merges, the refusal tests become merge tests in both key orders with an unmerged CONTROL, the census row keeps only the TODO, and the prose moves with it); with it the change is non-breaking and the lines go back to `yes (widening)` / `semantic`. On that build (one local commit, `4f8cfe7a`, on `263f6c89`; the patch is `/mnt/project-files/spec-seat1/28993-merge-fallback.patch` in the project's files) the targeted spec run (translation, conversions, migrations and the census pin) read 30 files / 1244 tests passed, the spec build and `check:generated` were green, `check:adr-0087-registration` read "this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset", and `check-changeset-no-major --event` with the lines swapped exited 0 (`yes (widening)` / `semantic`).
- **The save door.** Measured with a held-mutation probe: `saveMetaItem` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) runs `schema.safeParse(item)` and stores the request body verbatim for every type except `view`, plus four named grafts, so a schema transform never reaches storage. Storing the parsed locale there is a domain:server slice; the seat files it. Until it lands, a lowercase save is raw at rest and the case entry keeps folding it on every read.
- `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts` and its test describe a bundle as `z.record(LocaleSchema, TranslationDataSchema)` in comments. The key schema is now a shape-only twin of `LocaleSchema`; the comments' point (keys are locale codes, groups live one level down) still holds. Not changed here.
